description: Aturan validasi input di seluruh API Tanamanku.
principle: Semua input API divalidasi di server (Laravel FormRequest). Frontend boleh memvalidasi untuk UX, tetapi server tetap otoritas final.

locations.backend: app/Http/Requests — per modul (Auth, Product, Cart, Order, Garden, Plant, Community, Service)
locations.web: Validasi form ringan di sisi klien (UX) sebelum submit
locations.mobile: Validasi form di sisi klien (UX) sebelum submit

Auth: register: name (required, min 3), email (required, email, unique), password (required, min 8, confirmed), phone (optional, numeric)
Product: name (required, max 191), slug (unique), price (required, numeric, min 0), stock (integer, min 0)
category_id (exists:categories), store_id (exists:stores, milik seller), images (image, max 2MB per file)
Cart: product_id (exists, aktif), quantity (integer, min 1, max stok tersedia)
Service: service_id (exists, aktif), schedule_at (date, future), address_id (exists, milik user)
